# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment documents generated from the application source, configuration, and assessment results. Use the links below as a navigation starting point for the detailed architecture, dependency, API, data, configuration, and workflow analyses.

- [architecture-diagram](architecture-diagram.md) - High-level application layering and detailed component relationships.
- [dependency-map](dependency-map.md) - Declared dependency inventory grouped by functional category with compatibility notes.
- [api-service-contracts](api-service-contracts.md) - REST endpoint catalog, management endpoints, DTOs, and communication patterns.
- [data-architecture](data-architecture.md) - Database configuration, entity model, repository methods, and data sensitivity summary.
- [configuration-inventory](configuration-inventory.md) - Profiles, properties, startup settings, secrets handling, and framework versions.
- [business-workflows](business-workflows.md) - Core domain workflows, business rules, and end-to-end sequence behavior.
